These edits add one learned scalar intercept per item after existing parameter initialization. All intercepts start at zero, preserving initial scores; padding_idx=0 keeps the padding intercept zero under the frozen optimizer settings. The frozen BPR objective can then learn item propensity independently of sequence-dependent embedding geometry.

Both training scores and both supported candidate layouts receive the intercept, with broadcasting and the existing single-sequence squeeze preserved. Interfaces, sequence encoding, blocks, existing parameter initialization, imports, constants, and host operations remain unchanged.

This is one candidate for the unchanged host protocol. Validation has not been run here; retain the change only if host validation HR@10 exceeds 0.635. The 0.645–0.655 range remains an unmeasured target.
